additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470086-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839008] Issue with payment terminal CRM:03056000868
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Tomas,
Good morning and Happy New year.
Thank you for raising the issue.
I have checked thoroughly the other two cases you have mentioned in the description.
ID0412734: Charger ID: gvtqYD  already closed by Joao with replacement order.
ID0466690: Charger ID: 6vMbOH  Already ordered by Francisco on  22/12/2025 and its depends on RC.
Now in this case I have checked thoroughly and found that there is a communication error in the Payment terminal.
Please do the following troubleshooting. If its still remain the error, please replace it.
``T
his error flag can be caused by network-related issues such as a
1. Defective or disconnected network cable,
2. A faulty network switch, or
3. Power supply problems with the payment terminal.
It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured. Additionally, ensuring all connections are secure and swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help identify if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows: Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2  1.``
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470086-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839008] Issue with payment terminal CRM:03056000868
additional_info.body:
Dear Harun,
Thank you and happy new year to you as well.
I suppose that since the Payment terminal does not boot at all and is freezed in booting screen (android as background and few lines of text). Because it always gets stuck during booting it will always has the Communication failure in the Error flags.
See for example mentioned case
ID0466690
: Charger ID:
6vMbOH
. There is exactly the same failure in Error flags. And also exactly the same problem with Payment Terminal (freezed during boot).
I am pretty sure it is because in the menu Change Configuration– General changes is set Valina as “Payment Terminal Type” which leads to this failure because the terminal is defective.
Because the terminal never boot-up it will never has the IP address which leads to this failure.
In short, there is no other solution than replacement of the terminal. This is our 3
rd
case we have faced so far. I have also a confirmation from the Valina support, this needs to be changed, not repairable on-site.
Thank you
BR Tomas Cepicka

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470086-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839008] Issue with payment terminal CRM:03056000868
additional_info.body:
Dear Harun,
I haven’t heard from you any updates. I expected an RMA or anything I could use to order a spare part. So, because our customer started to be a little nervous (case open more than 30 days) in the meantime I asked my colleague from sales to order a new terminal.
Two terminals actually, because we are facing issues in two open tickets – this one
ID0470086
and
ID0466690
.
However, the new two pieces I have received last Friday. Yesterday I wanted to commission both of them in the office in warm temperature and that I would not freeze outdoor if any complications occurs.
So, the terminal for the ticket
ID0466690
seems to be fine, there are obstacles but I need to get some technical support from Valina directly, it can’t download the SW update despite there is a newer version in the delivered terminal.
But the terminal for this ticket has again exactly the same problem – TAMPERED STATE. That is again ready for exchange and there is no way how we could fix it.
So I would like to ask you for an RMA that I could order a spare part.
Thank you in advance!
BR Tomas

additional_info.subject: Note from Product Champion - Investigation Status & Next Actions (8D report request)
additional_info.body:
Context:
Following alignment with the Heads of Departments and status verification with Tomas (CZ), the points below summarize the current investigation status and agreed next steps.
Status
It is confirmed that the
commissioning process failed during the software download phase
.
The CZ team and EDRI have already involved
Valina Expert Support
to address issues encountered during and after the firmware download. Specifically, Valina had to adjust certain parameters related to the terminal’s MAC address to enable successful software download.
In coordination with PLM, it has been confirmed that
spare parts currently exhibit a ~10% failure rate during commissioning
.
This is caused by
internal Valina bugs
, which may occur during updates and can result in the device entering
tampered mode
.
It is also confirmed that
sequential firmware updates can cause problems
, especially for spare parts stored long-term.
Some units contain
very old firmware
that triggers automatic updates upon power‑up, but the update sequence may become stuck due to the outdated FW baseline.
8D Goal & Scope
Enable QM to
investigate the root cause
of the tampered condition observed in the delivered spare part.
Initiate creation of a
Quality Feedback (Q‑fbk)
entry to ensure SI E maintains proper documentation for similar cases.
Drive changes ensuring that SI E
implements a refresher program
for Valina spare parts, preventing devices from remaining on outdated firmware.
Purpose / Expected Benefits
Prevent Valina devices from entering
tampered mode during on‑site commissioning
due to outdated firmware.
Reduce the likelihood of failures during
payment terminal replacement operations
.
Minimize
service time and associated costs
.
To Do
Contact the QM department to
initiate the 8D report
(requested by CS + QM + R&D Heads of Departments).
Responsible contact:
luis-miguel@siemens.com
Ensure that the TS team member who assumes ownership of this ticket coordinates and arranges the required support for payment terminal commissioning activities in alignment with the established process.
